page_title: MAR 2-0 NAN | Marseille v Nantes 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Amar Dedic (Marseille) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes way wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Louis Leroux (Nantes) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
86' Amar Dedic (Marseille) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar.
79' Substitution. Sorba Thomas (Nantes) replaces Marcus Coco.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Pedro Chirivella.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Bilal Nadir (Marseille) coming on for Mason Greenwood.
78' Here is a change. Pol Lirola is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Luiz Felipe (Marseille).

77' 2 - 0 Mason Greenwood (Marseille) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Anthony Lopes is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:0.
75' Louis Leroux (Nantes) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' 1 - 0 Goal! Valentin Rongier puts the ball across the area and Amine Gouiri (Marseille) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 1:0.
72' Meschack Elia (Nantes) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
72' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
70' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Moses Simon is replaced by Meschack Elia (Nantes).
70' Substitution. Matthis Abline makes his way off the pitch and Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) comes on as his replacement.
69' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
66' Amar Dedic (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
66' Marseille take a short corner kick.

64' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Amine Gouiri (Marseille) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
63' Louis Leroux (Nantes) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
62' Pol Lirola (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Anthony Lopes, who smothers the ball.
59' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Amar Dedic (Marseille) replaces Quentin Merlin.
58' It's time for a substitution. Valentin Rongier (Marseille) comes on in place of Ismael Bennacer.

57' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Anthony Lopes pulls off an easy save.
55' The corner from Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kelvin Amian (Nantes) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' What a huge chance for Amine Gouiri (Marseille). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
48' He should have scored! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
46' Half-time substitution. Antoine Kombouare decided to make a change. Francis Coquelin is replaced by Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
42' Louis Leroux (Nantes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
37' Wonderful movement by Marseille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) swings in a cross from the corner, but Anthony Lopes reads it well and gathers the ball.

34' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Mason Greenwood (Marseille), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul. Marseille are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
27' Luis Henrique (Marseille) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
25' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
24' Michael Murillo is being substituted because of an injury. Roberto De Zerbi sends Pol Lirola (Marseille) on the pitch.
23' Michael Murillo (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
21' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
20' The linesman raises his flag. Moses Simon (Nantes) is adjudged offside.
17' Geronimo Rulli pulls off a great save to deny Pedro Chirivella (Nantes), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
14' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
13' The goal by Marseille is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
12' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Marseille players aren’t happy.
11' Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Amine Gouiri finds Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
10' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post.
10' Marcus Coco (Nantes) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
8' Matthis Abline (Nantes) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
7' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.

4' Marseille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
3' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
